title: The Provision of Mount Kessler
author: Mirabel Coldharbour
blurb: Zephyrine Marchetti, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
